svg.text: Why History Independence Is Mandatory for Quantum Walkers (Bernstein [2009]):

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Insertion-History Leak: Path-copying AVL / Red-Black trees encode insertion order in tree

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: topology, entangling the quantum state with traversal history and destroying interference!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Canonical Crit-Bit + Bitonic Solution: Uniquely determined by the set S of keys:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: 1. Batcher Bitonic Network on N_sort = 2M = 2,048 items has (11 * 12)/2 = 66 stages.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: 2. Each compare-and-swap on w = 512-bit records uses 512 Toffolis ( comparator + CSWAP ).

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Amortized Cost / Lookup: 14,080 Toffolis (vs. 1,048,576 Linear Scan = 74.47x Faster!)

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Zero QROAM Fanout: All 1,024 walkers sort and query in O(log^2 M) depth simultaneously.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif
'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Amortized Online Insertion via Binary-Counter Bitonic Merge:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: New Item |x⟩ -⟶ [Compare-Swap Merge with L_0 (size 1)] -⟶ Carry Run of size 2

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: |⟶ If L_1 occupied: BitonicMerge(Carry_2, L_1) -⟶ Carry Run of size 4

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: |⟶ Stops at first empty slot L_k (where bit k of count n is 0)!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Run L_k of size 2^k is merged only once every 2^k insertions (cost: 2^k * k * w CCX).

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Amortized Insertion Cost across M=1,024 steps: O(w * log^2 M) = 46,541 Toffolis / step.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Preserves Canonical History Independence: Every populated run L_k is uniquely sorted!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif
